m19.text: The birth mountain is where the twin dragons Ugin and Nicol hatched, and Ugin flew back toward it alone, learning along the way that all things breathe.

When the twins reached it, they found human settlements with dragon skulls and carved gates showing dragons being killed, and poisoned bolts wounded Ugin before he landed on the mountain's rim, where Nicol vowed to avenge their sister.
From the mountain they waited overnight and met Chromium Rhuell in human form, who proposed destroying the dragon-killing chief and his heirs, though Nicol twisted his words.

Nicol then whispered into the mind of the chief's son, set the heirs against each other, burned the temple and proclaimed himself the humans' true leader, and Ugin realized his twin had never truly cared for him.
In the story of the king's later wars, Nicol turned dragon against dragon and ignited clan wars, while the king ruled as a just king after losing his brother Ugin to a blast of sorcery.
